text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
She has displayed a masterclass run!
The powerhouse rookie, Mihono Bourbon—!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Order completed.
I have returned, Master.
choice_data_list: That was a wonderful debut race!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
I was able to demonstrate my current abilities to the fullest.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Saving today's records and ambient data.
Aiming for further improvement toward achieving the Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Order received.
I will do my best alongside you, Master.
The next day. While walking through the shopping district, I heard a familiar name come from an electronics store TV.

text_block_list.name: TV Announcer
text_block_list.text: "A massive rookie who's been racking up achievements with overwhelming speed since before entering school, Mihono Bourbon!"

text_block_list.name: TV Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"Expectations are soaring for her future performances!
Everyone, how did you find her debut race!?"

The news transitioned to
interviews with the visitors.

text_block_list.name: Female Spectator
text_block_list.text: ""I've been cheering for her for so long, so I was beyond excited for her long-awaited debut race!""

text_block_list.name: Male Spectator
text_block_list.text:
"That was a fantastic run!
It really gave me a boost of energy too."

—And then, I noticed another Umamusume gazing
intently at the screen as well.

Rice wishes she could become
like that in the Twinkle Series too...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if I can say goodbye
to the "Rice Shower" that brings misfortune to everyone...

Before disturbing her focused gaze,
I quietly left the area.
